title: Reproduction of the 2023 optical experiment (Zenodo 7979319)
caption: Reproduction from real photon data: Schiansky et al., Nat. Commun. 14, 3849 (2023), doi:10.1038/s41467-023-39519-w; dataset Zenodo record 7979319 (doi:10.5281/zenodo.7979319), Archive.zip sha256 ef73667fa87786c52340c6f3eec7cf0ccc3eb64e8fb785bdf54349e6dc800130 (upstream md5:fd708578a613b63f57c31f986a56bf94). Orange squares: per-run error rate (errors/sifted coincidences) with Clopper-Pearson 95% intervals, which understate the spread because runs are overdispersed (X runs chi2/dof = 9.9). Dashed line and band: published value +/- quoted uncertainty (PUBLISHED_AGGREGATE). Thin orange line: this work's state-averaged estimator. Right: residual timing drift within each run after alignment. Run-to-run overdispersion, not temporal drift: holdout runs 6-10 vs calibration runs 0-5 do not differ (run-level Welch test, p = 0.33); a pooled iid two-proportion test (p = 0.0034) is invalid under this dispersion. Run order is the archive chunk index (assumed acquisition order). Lane E manifest: schiansky2023-x07-reproduction.
